method.jvm: ThreadMXBean current-thread allocated bytes after at least 15 seconds warmup and explicit guest compilation, 3 samples of 256 calls. Includes host entry work on this thread; excludes allocations by other threads.
method.native: Difference in GHC RTS total allocated bytes for separate processes of 272 and 16 calls, divided by 256. Startup and reporting overhead approximately cancel. Same 16-input cycle and measured native binary.
method.scope: Allocation volume, not retained heap or peak process memory. Separate from throughput timing and graph capture.

disposition: Rejected experiment: PE-constant gating removes the introduced boxing regression but also loses the intended cached-header optimization. The final runtime returns to phase1.
